:::note[Generated]
The resources the server lists in `resources/list` and `resources/templates/list`. Generated from turf-mcp-server v1.4.0 by `scripts/generate-reference.mjs`: change the server, then run `npm run generate`.

The server lists one resource and four resource templates. A template's `{name}` parts are filled in to read one; `{?name}` is an optional query parameter.

## Resources

### Turf workspaces

`turf://workspaces`

The open workspaces: each binding's configuration, backend and lineage, and the convergence holding it.

| MIME type | Tiers |
|---|---|
| `application/json` | read · plan · apply · full |

## Resource templates

### Turf workspace

`turf://workspaces/{alias}`

One workspace ({alias}; 'default' for the unnamed one): its binding, and what the engine holds for it — its serial, its round history, and the convergence holding it.

| MIME type | Tiers |
|---|---|
| `application/json` | read · plan · apply · full |

### Turf convergence

`turf://workspaces/{alias}/convergences/{id}`

One convergence this server follows: where it stands, the plan waiting at its approval point, and every round so far.

| MIME type | Tiers |
|---|---|
| `application/json` | read · plan · apply · full |

### Turf round plan

`turf://workspaces/{alias}/convergences/{id}/rounds/{round}/plan{?show_sensitive}`

A round's plan as `tofu show -json` prints it: the document the engine captured for the round as its plan sealed, the same however often it is read, kept for the engine's retention after the round ends. Sensitive values are redacted; ?show_sensitive=true reads the captured bytes in the clear, the ones plan.digest hashes, and a secret read so enters the conversation.

| MIME type | Tiers |
|---|---|
| `application/json` | read · plan · apply · full |

### Turf workspace state

`turf://workspaces/{alias}/state{?show_sensitive}`

A workspace's state as `tofu show -json` prints it, sensitive values redacted unless ?show_sensitive=true.

| MIME type | Tiers |
|---|---|
| `application/json` | read · plan · apply · full |
